metadata.description: CraftVideo: make a narrated motion-graphics video from a topic, or edit a recording professionally, with 3D and motion graphics for both. Swappable providers with contract checks and QA gates.

plugins.name: craftvideo
plugins.description: Make (research, storyboard, narrate, animate, score, mix, export) or edit (analyze, transcribe, cut dead air and fillers, clean and level audio, caption, reframe), with Three.js 3D, img2threejs models, WebGPU shaders, GSAP and transparent overlays. Voice, picture, mix, transcription and editing are swappable providers (VoiceStudio, EffectCraft, FilmCraft, ffmpeg, faster-whisper, HTML, OpenAI-compatible and command-line tools) with a conformance suite and editor timeline hand-off.
